text:
Leo (Partnerships): Quick check-in: Partner showcase at CloudSummit confirmed (May 30). We're running a 25m session: 8m Cloud marketplace walk-through, 10m joint live integration demo, 5m SI case study, 2m wrap/Qs. Need marketplace SKUs, speaker 1-liners, customs paperwork for swag, and a crisp demo handoff. Who can own marketplace listing?

Juno (Events): I can own stage ops + cue sheet. Rehearsal slot proposed May 29 09:00 PT. Need final slides by EOD May 27. Note: room A/V has ethernet only; we'll need a cellular hotspot fallback.

Rina (Field Marketing): Landing page needs: hero image, 50-word description, and a 10s demo GIF. Also request: co-branded thank-you email copy for registrants. Deadline: May 26. Can someone push final approved logos (SVG) to the shared drive?

Omar (Solutions): Demo architecture: live call to marketplace deploy -> Redwood Hosted API -> optional on-device inference on EdgeHW. I'll provide a deterministic demo script and a short local smoke test. Suggested smoke test (curl):

curl -s -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_KEY' -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq -r '.choices[0].text'

Also adding a small telemetry flag `DEMO_MODE=true` so ops can see if the demo ran as expected.

Nina (Logistics): Swag manifest: 200 promo totes, 120 stickers, 40 demo dongles. Shipping manifest: EH-912-US -> partner aircargo. ETA to venue dock: May 29 07:00. Need customs CN22 copy for international outbound (partners in EU). Volunteer pickup: two people required (ID + partner PO). Can we confirm volunteers?

Yusuf (Legal): Quick compliance note: any partner co-marketing must include partner-approved trademarks and marketing consent. Send me final logos and copy for a 24h legal review; if not received by May 24 we'll have to use partner names only (no logos). Also confirm prize sweepstakes rules if giving away devices.

Leo (Partnerships): Marketplace owner: +Rina? (for copy) +Omar (for deploy endpoint and demo GIF). Alex from CloudPartner asked for SKU mapping and test deploy link by May 25. @CloudPartner we'll need the production pricing metadata to show in the live marketplace.

Juno (Events): Stage cue plan: host intro (1:00), CloudPartner demo (4:00), handoff overlay + 10s countdown, EdgeHW demo (4:00), SI use-case (4:30), audience Qs (2:30). I'll post a one-page cheat sheet in #events-backstage.

Rina (Field Marketing): Volunteers: I can get Maya and Jon to pick up swag at 06:30 on May 29. Will DM Nina with contact names. Also planning a 15s TikTok-style clip after demo to push social. Need partner approval for short clip.

Omar (Solutions): Handoff detail: CloudPartner should end by pressing "handoff" button which toggles the demo to local mode. Implement UI event: `window.postMessage({type:'HANDOFF_REQUEST'})` to the overlay. EdgeHW will respond within 2s. We'll add a visual status toast: "Edge device live".

Nina (Logistics): Noted on volunteers. Also: secure storage at hotel for 40 demo dongles overnight. Need two signatures on check-out. Will create storage manifest and share.

Yusuf (Legal): FYI: EdgeHW dongles may require an export classification check depending on crypto libs. Omar, can you confirm firmware versions and whether HSM is used? If yes, we may need export paperwork.

Omar (Solutions): Confirmed: dongles run FW v1.2.3, no HSM, encryption limited to TLS 1.3. I'll send a short technical sheet to Yusuf.

BuildBot: Automated reminder: "CloudSummit Rehearsal" invite created for May 29 09:00 PT. Attendees: Leo, Juno, Rina, Omar, Nina, Yusuf.

Leo (Partnerships): Action items summary: 1) Rina upload logos + landing copy by May 26, 2) Omar provide demo GIF + smoke-test link by May 25, 3) Nina confirm customs & volunteer names by May 24, 4) Yusuf legal review by May 24, 5) Juno post stage cheat-sheet by May 28. Flag anything missing. :eyes:
